tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal snar thang pa'i lugs kyi seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs// margad 'khri shing gzhon nu ldem pa la// brgya byin tshon gyis bklubs ltar yid 'phrog gzugs// sna tshogs rgyan gos kyis mdzes rje btsun ma'i// sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ra'i lugs su spel// 'dir dpal ldan mar me mdzad nas brgyud pa'i dpal snar thang pa'i bka' srol seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tāṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas dbur brgyan pa'i rje btsun ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn ma ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥzhes pas bla ma dang yi dam la phyag byas/ oṃ ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo tāṃ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog margad ltar ljang zhing dri ma med pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thar kar kha bye ba/ ral pa phyed thor cog tu byas shing phyed g.yon phyogs su 'phyang ba/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/

zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ na ma ār+ya sogs kyi sngags kyis gong ltar phyag byas la mchod/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i phyag skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'i 'og tu bdag dang bskyab bya thams cad chud par bsams la/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa ci nus su 'don/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i tāṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gros mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ bstod pa'i nus pa 'grub par byed pa sngags yin pas/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā zhes pa'i sngags kyis g.yas skor du yod pa klog pa'i tshul du yi ge bcu pa brgya rtsa sogs ci nus su bzlas mthar/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la sngar bzhin mchod/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes lta bu'i gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa 'og min du gshegs par bsams/ nyer bsdu ni rang nyid lha'i sku gdan dang bcas pa rim gyis 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar thim zhing*/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag de las ldang ba na skad cig gis lha'i skur gyur par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur sogs// bsngo ba smon lam gang shes bya'o// de ltar byas pas gzhung nas 'byung ba'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba mi bslu ba nyid do// 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma la bya ba thams cad snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi chings ji lta ba bzhin byas pas grub bo// smras pa/ 'phags mas rjes bzung mar me mdzad dpal gyi// zhal lung byin rlabs ma nyams gdams pa'i bcud// mchims chen thugs kyi yol gor 'khyil ba gang*// las bzang thar pa'i 'chi med gsos su bskrun// 'jigs brgyad zung gi chu srin gdug pa'i gnas// chen po'i pha rol legs son bde mchog gi /yid bzhin nor bu len par 'dod pa des// dam pas legs gsungs dri med gru 'di zung*// dge bas bdag dang sems can ma lus pa// bya grub phrin las sprul pa'i lha mo yi// skyabs sbyin phyag gi dpag bsam brkyang ba'i grib// dngos grub 'dod dgu'i snye mar rtsen gyur cig /ces dpal snar thang pa'i lugs kyi seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di'ang sgrol bstod yi dam du byed pa'i don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris so// // ༄// rje btsun sgrol ma'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig la brten pa'i bstod sgrub shel gyi pi wang zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang sku mdzes sdug ri mo yid la bkod// snyan 'jebs bstod pa'i rgyud stong 'khrol shes na// mngon 'dod 'bras bus re skong rje btsun ma'i// bstod sgrub shel gyi pi wang 'di na sbreng*// de'ang rje btsun sgrol ma bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod kyin sgrub pa'i tshul la/

thog mar sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing rje btsun ma bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs 'gro// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i dge bas// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas thob shog /ces lan gsum/ de nas don yid la dran bzhin pas 'di skad do// mdun du sdong bu rab rgyas rtse mor// chu skyes 'dab stong ge sar dgod par// bung ba myos pa'i glu len dbus na// dkar bsil zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan steng*// hrīḥdakar 'od kyi drwa ba dkrigs las// legs skyes lha mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang*// dar bab lang tsho zla zhal rgyas par// spyan zung zim mer 'gro la gzigs pas// dgyes 'dzum dkar pos mdun nas bsu snyam// spyi bor 'od dpag med pas mtshan zhing*// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bzhugs// ri dwags pags pas myos bum bkab nas// 'ja' tshon la 'khu sna tshogs dar dang*// sil sil sgra 'khrol rin chen rgyan mdzes// mu tig 'khri shing lta bu'i phyag g.yas// mchog sbyin brkyang zhing g.yon pas pad+ma'i// yu ba mtheb mdzub kyis bzung 'dab stong*// thugs ka'i thad kar phye ba'i dbus na// rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol ma// margad 'khri shing gzhon nu ldem 'dra// rked skabs phra ldem nu 'bur mngon mtho// zur gyis blta sogs yid 'phrog tshul 'chang*// rin chen gser gyi sor gdub spras pa'i// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin res 'ga' skyabs sbyin// cig shos sdong bu bzung ba'i ut+pal// 'bras bu me tog gong bu gsum mdzes// legs bris gos dang rin chen rgyan 'chang*// 'jam mnyen zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs mdzad// 'khor ba ngan song 'jigs las bskyab slad// zhal 'dzum dmu ler bdag la gzigs bzhugs// lha rdzas me tog spos dang mar me// dri zhim ro brgya'i bza' bas mdun bdar// grangs med skye bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung*// gnyen po stobs bzhi ldan pas mthol bshags// 'khor 'das dge ba'i chu gter bye ba// yid rang zla gzhon khrod kyis cher spel// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gis stong*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems mchog gzung ngo*// bla ma dkon mchog gsum 'dus khyed ni// byang chub bar gyi skyabs su gzung bgyi// gzhan don sangs rgyas sgrub par dam bca'i// rdo rje'i mdud pa snying la 'cha'o// gang 'tsham thabs mkhas sngags kyi spyod pas// sems can rgya mtsho smin cing grol bgyi// rnam dkar dge ba'i bi shwa karmas// lhun grub sku gsum gzugs brgya bskrun shog
/ces dang*/ de nas sgrol ma'i sku de nyid la dmigs te yi ge bcu pa ci nus shig bzlas

spro na sgrol ma'i gzungs ring yang bzla/ la/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad yin snyam// brag ca'i sgra dbyangs snyan pos bstod pa// oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma sogs bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa ci nus kyi mthar/ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pa'i sogs nas bgegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms gyur ces pa'i bar ram lung bstan par yang bdag gis de thob shog ces pa'i bar brjod la/ rgyal yum sgrol ma khyed sku ci 'dra// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur mdzod// mdun gyi lha gsum 'od du zhu gyur// rang dang dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang las// rang nyid sgrol ma yid 'phrog cha lugs// spyi bor 'od dpag med pas mtshan gyur// ces brjod la/ slar yang bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa 'don pa'am/ sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying ga'i pad zlar tām̐ gyi mdun rgyab// oṃ hā bar du bdag gi tshe dang*// bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig /'dab brgyad yi ge brgyad pos bskor gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa bzlas la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag gis// rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub par gyur nas// 'gro ba rgya mtsho ma lus par yang*// de yi go 'phang 'khrid par gyur cig /ces pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o// yang srod dus sam gdon bgegs che ba'i gnas su sdod pa'i tshe sgrol ma khro mo bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol ma// zhes pa yan chad sngar bzhin dang*/ zla shel 'khri shing g.yo 'dra'i khro mo// spyan gsum dmar zlum mche ba rab gtsigs// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar tshul// cig shos phyag mthil sa la brdabs pas// sa gsum yam mor g.yo bar byas slar// sdigs mdzub 'bar ba thugs kar rab bsgreng*// rin chen rgyan dang lto 'phye'i ga shal// stag gzig pags pas stod smad gcer skyob// me dpung klong na brkyang bskum stabs mdzad// byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs dgra gzhom slad// smin 'khyog g.yon phyogs lta ba'i tshul bzhugs// lha rdzas me tog ma yan chad gong dang 'dra bar brjod/

rang la bstim pa'i tshe/ rang nyid sgrol ma khro mo'i cha lugs zhes bsgyur/ sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying ga'i pad zlar tām̐ gyi mdun rgyab// oṃ hā bar du bdag ni nad dang*// gdon bgegs 'jigs pa kun las srungs srungs// bcu gnyis 'dab mar yi ge gsal gyur// ces brjod la/ oṃ na ma tā re ma no ha ra hūm̐ ha ra swā hā zhes pa bzlas/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs sngar dang 'dra'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bstod pa 'don pa la brtson par byas na gzhung nas bstan pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni mi bslu ba nyid do// smras pa/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lha// byang chub spyad pa dpag yas spyod pa na// gdul dka'i mi srun gzigs pa'i snying rje'i shugs// mchi ma'i rgyun chen las 'khrungs sgrol ma zhes// 'dis kyang 'gro tshogs srid pa'i chu gter las// sgrol ba'i g.yar dam rmad byung lhun po'i khur// dka' spyad phrag par bkod la rnam par snang*// dgyes pa'i dbyangs kyis bsngags pa nyi shu gcig /su zhig mgrin par brgyan pa'i g.yang lam du// dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston pa'i bstod sgrub tshul// sa skya'i bla chen zhal lung gdams pa'i mtsho// bsrubs las skyes pa'i kun phan dkyil 'khor 'di// legs bris dge ba'i rin chen zom stegs brten// 'gro tshogs 'khor ba ngan song 'jigs brgyad kyi// chu bo las brgal bde ldan mgon po yi// legs gsungs bdud rtsi 'thung ba nyid gyur cing*// ces rje btsun sgrol ma'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig la brten pa'i bstod sgrub shel gyi pi wang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sgrol bstod thugs dam gyi snying por bcang ba ldan shod sa 'dzin dam pa mgon po rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba 'phral du ma grub par 'gyangs par gyur pa slar rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed kyi gnam lo'i 'bras ldan khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum par ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa 'gro la phan par gyur cig
sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
